input.manimCode:
from manim import *

class StoryboardScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        # Frame 1: The problem: searching in a sorted list
        title = Text("The problem: searching in a sorted list")
        self.add(title)
        self.wait(8)
        self.clear()
        # Frame 2: Check the middle, then discard half
        title = Text("Check the middle, then discard half")
        self.add(title)
        self.wait(10)

issues.description: The frame likely lacks hierarchy: a single title may not communicate the 'sorted list' visualElements clearly enough for beginners.
issues.suggestedFix: Ensure the sorted array is visually represented (e.g., multiple labeled boxes) and keep the title smaller than the primary visual so the concept reads instantly.

issues.description: The storyboard calls for showing both a middle marker and discarding half; if the visuals are only text, viewers may not understand the compare-and-discard action.
issues.suggestedFix: Depict the midpoint explicitly and visually fade/shade the discarded half so the audience can see the narrowing step, not just hear it.
